ai_summary: Eris Lifesciences delivered strong Q1 FY26 PAT/EPS growth of 41%, driven by robust domestic branded business segment growth (11% vs. IPM) and significant margin expansion in the acquired Biocon segment. However, consolidated revenue growth was moderated to 7.4% due to a strategic ramp-down of trade generics and lumpy exports, while persistent insulin drug product shortages led to a revenue hit and increased working capital. Despite a temporary increase in net debt, the company remains focused on its high-potential GLP-1 opportunity with Semaglutide development on track and its reoriented international CDMO business poised for future growth, though near-term export capacity constraints persist.
